name: restoration
description: URL plan + content map template for damage restoration contractors (water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, commercial). Targets local-commercial search intent with dense city x service cross-product pages.
notes: Restoration is overwhelmingly local_emergency / local_commercial intent. Plan defaults reflect that.
Cross-product pages (/service-areas/{city}/{service}/) are the primary SEO lever in this vertical and are enabled by default.
Biohazard / trauma cleanup pages require sensitive-content guardrails handled at Skill 3 (content generation) time.
